description: Move N working days from a date, skipping weekends and holidays; returns the end date and every skipped day with its reason. Delivery promises, SLA clocks, payment terms in business days. Example: start_date '2026-12-23', days 5, country 'DE', subdivision 'BY'. Calendar selection: country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. 'SA', 'DE', 'US') or market (MIC, e.g. 'XNYS', 'XLON'); optional subdivision (state/province/emirate code from list_calendars), categories (e.g. ['public','bank']), weekend override (['FRI','SAT']), extra_holidays (company/contract dates). Weekend defaults to the country's legal weekend. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = fixed-date calendar; medium = a lunar/moon-sighted or projected holiday is involved, or the caller overrode the weekend), estimated_items[] naming each projected date, sources[] (public references behind the calendar), data_version and warnings[].

categories.description: Holiday categories to count as non-working; default ['public']. Others per country: bank, government, school, optional, half_day, catholic…
categories.title: Categories

count_start_day.description: If true and start_date is a working day it counts as day 1. Default false (start the day after).
count_start_day.title: Count Start Day

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Required unless market is given.
country.title: Country

days.description: Working days to add; negative counts backwards.
days.title: Days

extra_holidays.description: Additional non-working ISO dates (company closures, contract-specific days).
extra_holidays.title: Extra Holidays

include_estimated_holidays.description: Count projected lunar/moon-sighted holidays as non-working (true) or ignore them until announced (false).
include_estimated_holidays.title: Include Estimated Holidays

language.description: Language for holiday names where available (e.g. 'ar', 'de', 'en_US'). Default: the country's own.
language.title: Language

market.description: Financial market MIC (XNYS, XLON, XETR, XHKG, XJPX, XSAU…) — trading/settlement calendar instead of a country.
market.title: Market

subdivision.description: Sub-national code (US 'CA', DE 'BY', AE 'DU', CA 'ON', AU 'NSW', IN 'KA'…). See list_calendars.
subdivision.title: Subdivision

weekend.description: Override the weekend, e.g. ['FRI','SAT'] or ['SUN']. Default: the country's legal weekend.
weekend.title: Weekend

name: add_working_days
title: Add or subtract working days
